confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Los Angeles pricing for a July peak-season window; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by neighborhood, event dates, and lead time. Cocktail and wine were set at about 1.6 to 1.7 times the beer anchor, consistent with the local beer relationship, because direct bar-price recall is weaker. Restaurant anchors are pre-tax, pre-tip menu prices; lodging anchors are base nightly rates before occupancy taxes. FX came from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages, not a direct page read; the 15 October figure matched across two searches but was not independently confirmed on the page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used; the estimate is based on general pricing for large US West Coast metros, with Los Angeles's high summer lodging demand reflected in the accommodation anchors.
